# Game has reset. Blue squares at rows 49-53, cols 19-23 and 39-43.
# HUD bars are black (0 white pixels).
# Need to figure out the goal quickly.

print(f"Initial blue squares: {[(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in blues]}")

# Try moving UP
result = action(['UP'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
blues = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']

seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Try moving UP a few more times to see the range
for i in range(5):
    result = action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    blues = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']
    pos = [(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in blues]
    print(f"After UP {i+3}: {pos}, board_changed: {result.get('board_changed')}")
